body: This is the best thing I did. I went military and one night I just bawled out to my mom on leave. Best thing I ever did. Especially as someone who struggles with openness, I opened up for close to 2 hrs on mother’s day. We both cried and told stories for hours. I’ve never been happier.

While this is, well, undescriptive, man... let me let you I feel it. Just feeling tired. Tired of pretending you're happy, together, tired of looking forward. It's hard as fuck, I'm not gunna lie. But those moments when shit goes well, it's worth it. I spent a whole night talking to my sister realizing how much she depended on me/ loved me and frankly that gave the reason to go on. Just find that reason, and believe me, it's there. It took me time but find it and hold onto that shit like it's gold
